description: Bracken Hale walks the road out past the wall twice a week and checks what is on it, and the hounds go with her. She is short a pair of hands this week. It is a long walk in bad ground and the dogs do most of the work.
name: The Road and the Dogs

objectives.desc: Collect the hounds from Bracken Hale
emotes: {who} gets the leads over their shoulder and lets four large animals decide how fast this is going to go.

objectives.desc: Walk the road out past the wall and check what is on it
emotes: {who} walks the line of poles, checking the fixings, straightening what has gone crooked in the wind.
